visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of rounded tinted text cards: optional icon, heading and paragraphs
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; 2 cards side by side from 600px when there are 2 or 4; 3 or 4 in a row from 900px; equal-height cards with 12px radius

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, a single cell: optional icon image (first), heading (h3), one or more paragraphs (bold allowed)
contentPattern.sourceDescription: cmp-card text cards in a splitlayout (food-noise pink and light-blue cards, quality-weight-loss white cards with outlined icons)

usage: Food noise (pink 3-up, light-blue 2-up) and Life made lighter with quality weight loss (white 3-up with icons).
reuseGuidance: Use for short text-only cards with no link. Use cards-photo-cta for cards with a photo and CTA, cards-stats for number highlights.
